speaker: Patient
text: 10-month-old boy. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. The mother notes that the wheezing exacerbates when the child is crying, feeding, and when his neck is flexed. Additionally, there are instances where the child vomits after feeding.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngeal Cleft.

The combination of stridor, wheezing, and vomiting after feeding in an infant who has symptoms worsening with neck flexion strongly suggests a laryngotracheal cleft. I will confirm this by requesting a flexible laryngoscopy. REQUEST TEST: Flexible Laryngoscopy.
